title: Glossary
content: PCI Express Technology 974 ARI Alternative Routing‐ID Interpretation; optional feature that allows Endpoints to have more Functions that the 8 allowed normally . ASPM Active State Power Management: When enabled, this allows hardware to make changes to the Link power state from L0 to L0s or L1 or both. AtomicOps Atomic Operations; three new Requests added with the 2.1 spec revision. These carry out multipl e operations that are guaranteed to take place without interruption within the target device. Bandwidth Management Hardware‐ initiated changes to Link speed or width for the purpose of power conservation or reliability . BAR Base Address Register. Used by Functions to indicate the type and size of their local memory and IO space. Beacon Low‐frequency in‐band si gnal used by Devices whose main power has been shut off to signal that an event has occurred for which they need to have the power restored. This can be sent across the Link when the Link is in the L2 state. BER Bit Error Rate or Ratio; a measure of signal int egrity based on the number of transmission bit errors seen within a time period Bit Lock The process of acquiring the transmitter’ s precise clock frequency at the receiver. This is done in the CDR logic and is one of the first steps in Link Training. Block The 130‐bit unit sent by a Gen3 transmitter, made up of a 2‐bit Sync Fi eld followed by a group of 16 bytes. Term Definition

source_file: Mike Jackson, Ravi Budruk, Joseph Winkles, Don Anderson - PCI Express Technology 3.0-MindShare Press (2012).pdf
title: Glossary
content: Glossary 975 Block Lock Finding the Block boundaries at the Receiver when using 128b/130b encoding so as to recognize incoming Blocks. The process involves three phases. First, search the incoming stream for an EIEOS (Electrical Idle Exit Ordered Set) and adjust the internal Block boundary to match it. Next, search for the SDS (Start Data Stream) Ordered Set. After t hat, the receiver is locked into the Block boundary . Bridge A Function that acts as the interface between two buses. Switches and the Root Complex will implement bridges on their Ports to enable packet routing, and a bridge can also be made to connect between different protocols, such as between PCIe and PCI. Byte Striping Spreading the output byte stream across al l available Lanes. All available Lanes are used whenever sending bytes. CC Credits Consumed: Number of credits already used by the transmitter when calculating Flow Control. CDR Clock and Data Recovery logic used to recover the Transmitter clock from the incoming bit stream and then sample the bits to recognize pa tterns. For 8b/10b, that pattern, found in the COM, FTS, and EIEOS symbols, allows the logic to acquire Symbol Lock. For 128b/130b the EIEOS sequence is used to acquire Block Lock by going through the three phases of locking. Character Term used to describe the 8‐bit values to be communicated between Link neighbors. For Ge n1 and Gen2, these are a mix of ordinary data bytes (labeled as D characters) and special control values (labeled as K characters). For Gen3 there are no control characters because

content: values to be communicated between Link neighbors. For Ge n1 and Gen2, these are a mix of ordinary data bytes (labeled as D characters) and special control values (labeled as K characters). For Gen3 there are no control characters because 8b/10b encoding is no longer used. In that case, the characters all appear as data bytes. Term Definition

source_file: Mike Jackson, Ravi Budruk, Joseph Winkles, Don Anderson - PCI Express Technology 3.0-MindShare Press (2012).pdf
title: Glossary
content: PCI Express Technology 976 CL Credit Limit: Flow Control credits seen as available from the transmitter’ s perspective. Checked to verify whether enough credits are available to send a TLP . Control Character These are special characters (labeled as “K” characters) used in 8b/10b encoding that facilitate Link training and Ordered Sets. They are not used in Gen3, where there is no distinction betw een characters. Correctable Errors Errors that are corrected automatically by hardware and don’t require software attention. CR Credits Required ‐ this is the sum of CC and PTLP . CRC Cyclic Redundancy Code; added to TLPs and DLLPs to allow verifying error‐free transmission. The name means that the patterns are cyclic in nature and are redundant (they don’t add an y extra information). The codes don’t contain enough information to permit automatic error correction, but provide robust error detection. Cut‐Through Mode Mechanism by which a Switch allows a TLP to pass through, forwarded from an ingress Port to an egress Port without storing it first to check for errors. This involves a risk, since the TLP may be found to ha ve errors after part of it has already been forwarded to the egress Port. In that case, the end of the packet is modified in the Data Link Layer to have an LCRC value that is inverted from what it should be, and also modified at the Physical Lay er to have an End Bad (EDB) framing symbol for 8b/10b encoding or an EDB token for 128b/ 130b encoding. The combination tells the receiver that

title: Glossary
content: is inverted from what it should be, and also modified at the Physical Lay er to have an End Bad (EDB) framing symbol for 8b/10b encoding or an EDB token for 128b/ 130b encoding. The combination tells the receiver that the packet has been nullified and should be discarded without sending an ACK/NAK response. Data Characters Characters (labeled as “D” characters) that represent ordinary data and are di stinguished from control characters in 8b/10b. For Gen3, there is no distinction between characters. Term Definition

title: Glossary
content: Glossary 977 Data Stream The flow of data Blocks for Gen3 operation. The stream is entered by an SDS (Start of Data Stream Ordered Set) and exited with an EDS (End of Data Stream token). During a Data Stream, only data Blocks or the SOS are expected. When any other Ordered Sets are needed, the Data Stream must be exited and only re‐entered when more data Blocks are ready to send . Starting a Data Stream is equivalent to entering the L0 Link state, since Ordered Sets are only sent while in other LTSSM states, like Recovery . De‐emphasis The process of reducing the transmitter voltage for repeated bits in a stream. This has the effect of deemphasizing the low‐freq uency components of the signal that are known to cause trouble in a transmission medium and thus improves the signal integrity at the receiver. Digest Another name for the ECRC (End‐to‐End CRC) value that can optionally be appended to a TLP when it’ s created in the Transaction Layer. DLCMSM Data Link Control and Management State Machine; manages the Link Layer training process (which is primarily Flow Control initialization). DLLP Data Link Layer Packet. These are created in the Data Link Layer and are forwarded to the Physical Layer but are not seen by the Transaction Layer. DPA Dynamic Power Allocation; a new set of configuration registers with the 2.1 spec revision that defines 32 power substates under the D0 device power state, making it easier for soft ware to control device power options. DSP (Downstream Port) Port that faces

title: Glossary
content: Allocation; a new set of configuration registers with the 2.1 spec revision that defines 32 power substates under the D0 device power state, making it easier for soft ware to control device power options. DSP (Downstream Port) Port that faces downstream, like a Root Port or a Switch Downstream Port. This distinction is meaningful in the LTSSM because the Ports have assigned roles during some states. Term Definition

title: Glossary
content: PCI Express Technology 978 ECRC End‐to‐End CRC value, optionally appended to a TLP when it’ s created in the Transaction Layer. This enables a receiver to verify reliable packet transport from source to destination, regardless of how many Links were crossed to get there. Egress Port Port that has outgoing traffic. Elastic Buffer Part of the CDR logic, this buffer enables the receiv er to compensate for the difference between the transmitter and receiver clocks. EMI Electro‐Magnetic Interference: the emitted electrical noise from a system. For PCIe, both SSC and scrambling are used to attack it. Endpoint PCIe Function that is at the bottom of the PCI InvertedTree structure. Enumeration The process of system discovery in which sof tware reads all of the expected configuration locations to learn which PCI‐configurable Functions are visible and thus present in the system. Equalization The process of adjusting Tx and Rx values to compensate for actual or expected signal distortion through the transmission media. For Gen1 and Gen2, this takes the form of Tx De‐emphasis. For Gen3, an acti ve evaluation process is introduced to test the signaling environment and adjust the Tx settings accordingly , and optional Rx equalization is mentioned. Flow Control Mechanism by which transmitters avoid the risk of having packets rejected at a receiver due to lack of buffer space. The receiver sends periodic updates abou t available buffer space and the transmitter verifies that enough is available before attempting to send a packet. FLR Function‐Level Reset Term Definition

source_file: Mike Jackson, Ravi Budruk, Joseph Winkles, Don Anderson - PCI Express Technology 3.0-MindShare Press (2012).pdf
title: Glossary
content: Glossary 979 Framing Symbols The “start” and “end” control characters used in 8b/10b encoding that indicate the boundaries of a TLP or DLLP . Gen1 Generation 1, meaning designs created to be compliant with the 1.x version of the PCIe spec. Gen1, Gen2, Gen3 Abbreviations for the revisions of the PCIe spec. Gen1 = rev 1.x, Gen2 = rev 2.x, and Gen3 = rev 3.0 Gen2 Gene ration 2, meaning designs created to be compliant with the 2.x version of the PCIe spec. Gen3 Generation 3, meaning designs created to be compliant with the 3.x version of the PCIe spec. IDO ID‐based Ordering; when enabled, this allows TLPs from different Requesters to be forwarded out of order wi th respect to each other. The goal is to improve latency and performance. Implicit Routing TLPs whose routing is understood without reference to an address or ID. Only Message requests have the option to use this type of routing. Ingress Port Port that has incoming traffic. ISI Inter‐Symbol Interference; the effect on one bit time that is ca used by the recent bits that preceded it. Lane The two differential pairs that allow a transmit and receive path of one bit between two Ports. A Link can consist of just one Lane or it may contain as many as 32 Lanes. Lane‐to‐Lane Skew Difference in arrival times for bits on different Lanes. Receiv ers are required to detect this and correct it internally . Legacy Endpoint An Endpoint that carries any of three legacy items forward: support for IO transactions, support for

source_file: Mike Jackson, Ravi Budruk, Joseph Winkles, Don Anderson - PCI Express Technology 3.0-MindShare Press (2012).pdf
title: Glossary
content: Skew Difference in arrival times for bits on different Lanes. Receiv ers are required to detect this and correct it internally . Legacy Endpoint An Endpoint that carries any of three legacy items forward: support for IO transactions, support for local 32bit‐only prefetchable memory space, or support for the locked transactions. Term Definition

source_file: Mike Jackson, Ravi Budruk, Joseph Winkles, Don Anderson - PCI Express Technology 3.0-MindShare Press (2012).pdf
title: Glossary
content: PCI Express Technology 980 LFSR Linear‐Feedback Shift Register; creates a pseudo‐random pattern used to facilitate scrambling. Link Interface between two Ports, made up of one or more Lanes. LTR Latency‐Tolerance Reporting; mechanism that allows devices to report to the system how quickly they need to get service when they send a Request. Longer latencies afford more power management option s to the system. LTSSM Link Training and Status State Machine; manages the training process for the Physical Layer. Non‐posted Request A Request that expects to receive a Completion in response. For example, any read request would be nonposted. Non‐prefetchable Memory Memory that exhibits side effects when read. For example, a status register tha t automatically self‐clears when read. Such data is not safe to prefetch since, if the requester never requested the data and it was discarded, it would be lost to the system. This was an important distinction for PCI bridges, which had to guess about the data size on reads. If they knew it wa s safe to speculatively read ahead in the memory space, they could guess a larger number and achieve better efficiency . The distinction is much less interesting for PCIe, since the exact byte count for a transfer is included in the TLP , but maintaining it allows backward compatibility . Null ified Packet When a transmitter recognizes that a packet has an error and should not have been sent, the packet can be “nullified”, meaning it should be discarded and the receiver should behave as if it had never been sent. This problem

source_file: Mike Jackson, Ravi Budruk, Joseph Winkles, Don Anderson - PCI Express Technology 3.0-MindShare Press (2012).pdf
title: Glossary
content: When a transmitter recognizes that a packet has an error and should not have been sent, the packet can be “nullified”, meaning it should be discarded and the receiver should behave as if it had never been sent. This problem can arise when using “cut‐through” operation on a Switch. Term Definition

source_file: Mike Jackson, Ravi Budruk, Joseph Winkles, Don Anderson - PCI Express Technology 3.0-MindShare Press (2012).pdf
title: Glossary
content: Glossary 981 OBFF Optimized Buffer Flush and Fill; mechanism that allows the system to tell devices about the best times to initiate traffic. If devices send requests during optimal times and not during other times system power management will be improved. Ordered Sets Groups of Symbols sent as Physical Layer communication for Lane management. These often consist of just control characters for 8b/1 0b encoding. They are created in the Physical Layer of the sender and consumed in the Physical Layer of the receiver without being visible to the other layers at all. PCI Peripheral Component Interface. Designed to replace earlier bus designs used in PCs, such as ISA. PCI‐XP CI eXtended. Designed to correct the shortcomings of PCI and enable higher speeds. PME P ower Management Event; message from a device indicating that power‐related service is needed. Poisoned TLP Packet whose data payload was known to be bad when it was created. Sending the packet with bad data can be helpful as an aid to diagnosing the problem and determining a solution for it. Polarity Inversion The receiver’ s signal polarity is permitted to be connected backwards to support cases when doing so would simplify board layout. The receiver is required to detect this condition and internally invert the signal to correct it during Link Training. Port Input/output interface to a PCIe Link. Po sted Request A Request packet for which no completion is expected. There are only two such requests defined by the spec: Memory Writes and Messages. Term Definition

source_file: Mike Jackson, Ravi Budruk, Joseph Winkles, Don Anderson - PCI Express Technology 3.0-MindShare Press (2012).pdf
title: Glossary
content: PCI Express Technology 982 Prefetchable Memory Memory that has no side‐effects as a result of being read. That property makes it safe to prefetch since, if it’ s discarded by the intermediate buffer, it can always be read again later if needed. This was an important distinction for PCI bridges, which had to guess about the data size on reads. Prefetchable space allowed speculatively reading more data and gave a chance for better efficiency . The distinction is much less interesting for PCIe, since the exact byte count for a transfer is included in the TLP , but maintaining it allows backward compatibility . PTLP Pending TLP ‐ Flow Control credits needed to send the current TLP . QoS Quality of Service; the ability of the PCIe topology to assign different priorities for different packets. This could just mean giving preference to packets at arbitration points, but in more complex systems, it allows making bandwidth and latency guarantees for packets. Requester ID The configuration address of the Requester for a transaction, meaning the BDF (Bus, Device, and Function number) that corresponds to it. This will be used by the Completer as the return address for the resulting completion packet. Root Complex The components that act as the interface between the CPU cores in the system and the PCIe topology. This can consist of one or mo re chips and may be simple or complex. From the PCIe perspective, it serves as the root of the inverted tree structure that backward‐compatibility with PCI demands. Run Length The number of consecutive ones

title: Glossary
content: can consist of one or mo re chips and may be simple or complex. From the PCIe perspective, it serves as the root of the inverted tree structure that backward‐compatibility with PCI demands. Run Length The number of consecutive ones or zeros in a row. For 8b/10b encoding the run length is li mited to 5 bits. For 128b/130b, there is no defined limit, but the modified scrambling scheme it uses is intended to compensate for that. Term Definition

source_file: Mike Jackson, Ravi Budruk, Joseph Winkles, Don Anderson - PCI Express Technology 3.0-MindShare Press (2012).pdf
title: Glossary
content: Glossary 983 Scrambling The process of randomizing the output bit stream to avoid repeated patterns on the Link and thus reduce EMI. Scrambling can be turned off for Gen1 and Gen2 to allow specifying patterns on the Link, but it cannot be turned off for Gen3 because it does other work at that speed and the Link is not expected to be able to work reliably without it. SOS Skip Ordered Set ‐ used to compensate for the slight frequency difference between Tx and Rx. SSC Spread‐Spectrum Clocking. This is a method of reducing EMI in a system by allowing the clock frequency to vary back and forth across an allowed range. This spreads the emitted energy ac ross a wider range of frequencies and thus avoids the problem of having too much EMI energy concentrated in one particular frequency . Sticky Bits Status bits whose value survives a reset. This characteristic is useful for maintaining status information when errors are detected by a Function downstream of a Link that is no longer operating cor rectly . The failed Link must be reset to gain access to the downstream Functions, and the error status information in its registers must survive that reset to be available to software. Switch A device containing multiple Downstream Ports and one Upstream Port that is able to route traffic betw een its Ports. Symbol Encoded unit sent across the Link. For 8b/10b these are the 10‐bit values that result from encoding, while for 128b/130b they’re 8‐bit values. Symbol Lock Finding the Symbol boundaries at the

For 8b/10b these are the 10‐bit values that result from encoding, while for 128b/130b they’re 8‐bit values. Symbol Lock Finding the Symbol boundaries at the Receiver when using 8b/10b encoding so as to recognize incoming Symbols and thus the contents of packets. Symbol time The ti me it takes to send one symbol across the Link ‐ 4ns for Gen1, 2ns for Gen2, and 1ns for Gen3. Term Definition

title: Glossary
content: PCI Express Technology 984 TLP Transaction Layer Packet. These are created in the Transaction Layer and passed through the other layers. Token Identifier of the type of information being delivered during a Data Stream when operating at Gen3 speed. TPH TLP Processing Hints; these help system routing agents make choices to improve latency and traffic congestion. UI Unit Interval; the time it takes to se nd one bit across the Link ‐ 0.4ns for Gen1, 0.2ns for Gen2, 0.125ns for Gen3 Uncorrectable Errors Errors that can’t be corrected by hardware and thus will ordinarily require software attention to resolve. These are divided into Fatal errors ‐ those that render further Link operation unreliable, and Non‐fatal errors ‐ those that do not affect the Li nk operation in spite of the problem that was detected. USP Upstream Port, meaning a Port that faces upstream, as for an Endpoint or a Switch Upstream Port. This distinction is meaningful in the LTSSM because the Ports have assigned roles during Configuration and Recovery . Term Definition

title: Glossary
content: Glossary 985 Variables A number of flags are used to communicate events and status between hardware layers. These are specific to state transitions in the hardware are not usually visible to software. Some examples: —L i n k U p ‐ Indication from the Physical Layer to the Data Link Layer that training has completed and the Physical Layer is now operational. — idle_to_rlock_transitioned ‐ This counter tr acks the number of times the LTSSM has transitioned from Configuration.Idle to the Recovery .RcvrLock state. Any time the process of recognizing TS2s to leave Configuration doesn’t work, the LTSSM transitions to Recovery to take appropriate steps. If it still doesn’t work after 256 passes through Recovery (counter reaches FFh), then it goes back to Detec t to start over. It may be that some Lanes are not working. WA KE # S i de‐band pin used to signal to the system that the power should be restored. It’ s used instead of the Beacon in systems where power conservation is an important consideration. Term Definition

content: BY The Ultimate Tool to View, Edit and Verify Configuration Settings of a Computer MindShare Arbor is a computer system debug, validation, analysis and learning tool that allows the user to read and write any memory, IO or configuration space address. The data from these address spaces can be viewed in a clean and informative style as well as checked for configuration errors and non-optimal settings. View Reference Info MindShare Arbor is an excellent reference tool to quickly look at standard PCI, PCI-X and PCIe structures. All the register and field definitions are up-to-date with the PCI Express 3.0. x86, ACPI and USB reference info will be coming soon as well. Decoding Standard and Custom Structures from a Live System MindShare Arbor can perform a scan of the system it is running on to record the config space from all PCI-visible functions and show it in a clean and intuitive decoded format. In addition to scanning PCI config space, MindShare Arbor can also be directed to read any memory address space and IO address space and display the collected data in the same decoded fashion. Write Capability MindShare Arbor provides a very simple interface to directly edit a register in PCI config space, memory address space or IO address space. This can be done in the decoded view so you see what the meaning of each bit, or by simply writing a hex value to the target location. Saving System Scans (XML) After a system scan has been performed, MindShare Arbor allows saving of that system's scanned data (PCI config

Saving System Scans (XML) After a system scan has been performed, MindShare Arbor allows saving of that system's scanned data (PCI config space, memory space and IO space) all in a single file to be looked at later or sent to a colleague. The scanned data in these Arbor system scan files (.ARBSYS files) are XML-based and can be looked at with any text editor or web browser. Even scans performed with other tools can be easily converted to the Arbor XML format and evaluated with MindShare Arbor. Run Rule Checks of Standard and Custom Structures In addition to capturing and displaying headers and capability structures from PCI config space, Arbor can also check the settings of each field for errors (e.g. violates the spec) and non-optimal values (e.g. a PCIe link trained to something less than its max capability). MindShare Arbor has scores of these checks built in and can be run on any system scan (live or saved). Any errors or warnings are flagged and displayed for easy evaluation and debugging. MindShare Arbor allows users to create their own rule checks to be applied to system scans. These rule checks can be for any structure, or set of structures, in PCI config space, memory space or IO space. The rule checks are written in JavaScript. (Python support coming soon.) source_file: PCIe_3.0_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
chapter: PCIe 3.0 架構與協定疊總覽
section: PCIe 3.0 架構與協定疊總覽
title: PCIe 3.0 架構與協定疊總覽
content: 知識藍圖封面。以介面與 trace routing blueprint 為視覺中心，標示 Transaction Layer、Data Link Layer、Physical Layer 及系統端點。

source_file: PCIe_3.0_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
chapter: 從平行匯流排到序列點對點
section: 從平行匯流排到序列點對點
title: 從平行匯流排到序列點對點
content: 比較 PCI/PCI-X 的共享平行匯流排、共同 clock、仲裁與頻寬共享，和 PCI Express 的專用 serial link、embedded clock、differential signaling 與可擴展 lane width。

source_file: PCIe_3.0_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
title: PCIe 系統拓撲
content: 展示 CPU/Memory、Root Complex、Switch、Bridge、Endpoint 的倒樹狀 switched fabric。Switch 提供 fan-out，Bridge 連接舊匯流排，Endpoint 是最終功能。

source_file: PCIe_3.0_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
title: 三層協定封裝
content: Transaction Layer 組裝 TLP 並負責交易/路由/QoS；Data Link Layer 加 Sequence Number 與 LCRC、處理 Ack/Nak；Physical Layer framing、encoding、scrambling、striping 並送上 serial bitstream。

source_file: PCIe_3.0_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
title: TLP 封包與交易類型
content: TLP 由 12/16-byte Header、0-4096-byte optional payload、optional 4-byte ECRC 組成。Non-Posted Request 需要 Completion；Posted Request 如 Memory Write 不等待 Completion。

source_file: PCIe_3.0_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
title: 三種 TLP 路由
content: Address Routing 用於 Memory/I/O，依 address 與 BAR/Base-Limit window；ID Routing 用 BDF，常用於 Configuration 與 Completion；Implicit Routing 用預設拓撲方向，常用於 Message。

source_file: PCIe_3.0_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
title: QoS 與 Virtual Channel
content: Traffic Class 經 TC-to-VC Mapping 映射到 Virtual Channel。各 VC 具有 Flow Control 資源，並由 strict priority 或 weighted round-robin 等 arbitration 共用 physical link。

source_file: PCIe_3.0_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
title: Credit-Based Flow Control
content: Receiver 先公告 buffer credits，Transmitter 只在 credit 足夠時送 TLP；Receiver 釋放 buffer 後以 FC_Update DLLP 更新。此機制避免 PCI retry/disconnect 與 buffer overflow。

source_file: PCIe_3.0_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
title: Data Link 封裝與 DLLP
content: 每個 TLP 在單一 Link 加上 Sequence Number 與 4-byte LCRC。DLLP 是獨立 8-byte link-local packet，承載 Ack/Nak、Flow Control 與 Power Management 等。

source_file: PCIe_3.0_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
title: Ack/Nak 與 Replay
content: Transmitter 把未確認 TLP 保存在 Replay Buffer；Receiver 驗證 LCRC/Sequence，成功回 Ack、錯誤回 Nak；Nak 或 timeout 觸發 replay，形成逐跳可靠性迴路。

source_file: PCIe_3.0_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
title: Transaction Ordering
content: 以 Producer/Consumer 說明 data write、flag write、read completion 的排序需求；同時指出 Relaxed Ordering 與 ID-Based Ordering 可在無資料相依時改善效能。

source_file: PCIe_3.0_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
title: Physical Logical Pipeline
content: 展示 byte striping 把 packet bytes 分到 x4/x8/x16 lanes，並以 scrambling 改善 transition density/頻譜；接收端做逆向還原。

source_file: PCIe_3.0_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
title: Gen1/2 與 Gen3 編碼
content: Gen1/2 的 8b/10b 約有 20% 編碼 overhead；Gen3 的 128b/130b 約 1.5%，以 8.0 GT/s 達到接近 1 GB/s/lane/direction 的有效資料率。

source_file: PCIe_3.0_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
title: 系統除錯與驗證
content: 以 MindShare Arbor 為例，將 Configuration Space 視覺化並執行規則檢查，協助把 hex register dump 轉為具體違規與分析結果。

source_file: PCIe_3.0_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
chapter: Memory Read 端到端跨層流程
section: Memory Read 端到端跨層流程
title: Memory Read 端到端跨層流程
content: 由核心提出 Memory Read Request，Transaction Layer 組 TLP，Data Link 加 Sequence/LCRC，Physical Layer 編碼傳送；Switch 驗證並依 address routing 轉送，Completer 回 Completion with Data。

source_file: 01_架構與拓撲.md
title: 一句話模型
content: PCIe 是保留 PCI 軟體模型、改用「序列、點對點、全雙工、封包式」傳輸的交換式互連。軟體仍以 Bus/Device/Function、Configuration Space 與 BAR 管理裝置；硬體連線則不再是所有裝置共享同一條平行匯流排。〔BOOK p.98-107；BP p.2-3〕

source_file: 01_架構與拓撲.md
section: 為何從 PCI/PCI-X 轉向 PCIe
title: 為何從 PCI/PCI-X 轉向 PCIe
content: PCI/PCI-X 的共享平行匯流排會遇到： - 多裝置共享頻寬，需要中央仲裁，一次只能由一個 Bus Master 使用匯流排。 - 位址與資料多工、turn-around cycle、retry/disconnect 等機制降低效率。 - 隨頻率上升，clock skew、signal skew、反射、負載數與走線長度更難控制。 - 平行匯流排腳位多，擴充頻寬常伴隨成本與拓撲限制。 PCIe 把每一段連線改成兩個裝置間的專用 Link；資料與控制資訊被封裝在封包中，Switch 可同時處理不同埠之間的流量。這是 switched fabric，不是共享 bus。〔BOOK p.68-97、98-105；BP p.2-3〕

source_file: 01_架構與拓撲.md
title: Link、Lane、方向與頻寬
content: - **Link**：兩個 PCIe Port 之間的點對點連線。 - **Lane**：一組發送差動對加一組接收差動對，可同時雙向傳輸。 - **Link Width**：x1、x2、x4、x8、x12、x16、x32；增加 Lane 數可線性增加理論頻寬。 - **Gen1**：2.5 GT/s，8b/10b；每 Lane 單方向有效資料率約 250 MB/s。 - **Gen2**：5.0 GT/s，8b/10b；每 Lane 單方向約 500 MB/s。 - **Gen3**：8.0 GT/s，128b/130b；每 Lane 單方向約 985 MB/s，常近似為 1 GB/s。 原書的 aggregate bandwidth 把雙向同時計入，因此 Gen3 x16 列為 32 GB/s；討論效能時必須先說清楚是「單方向」或「雙向合計」。〔BOOK p.102、105；BP p.13〕

source_file: 01_架構與拓撲.md
title: 倒樹狀拓撲
content: PCIe 為了維持 PCI 軟體相容性，採簡單倒樹狀階層，不允許任意迴圈。CPU/Host 在樹根，裝置位於下游。〔BOOK p.107；BP p.3〕 | 元件 | 角色 | 重要特性 | |---|---|---| | Root Complex (RC) | CPU/Memory 與 PCIe fabric 的介面 | 代表處理器發出交易；Root Port 是拓撲入口 | | Root Port | RC 對外的 PCIe Port | 對軟體呈現 Type 1 Header/虛擬 PCI-to-PCI Bridge | | Switch | Fan-out、aggregation、TLP routing | 一個 Upstream Port、多個 Downstream Port；每個 Port 含自己的 Link 層與 PHY | | Endpoint | 最終功能裝置 | 例如 NVMe、NIC、GPU；外部點對點 Link 上通常是 Device 0 | | Bridge | 連接 PCIe 與其他 bus | 例如 PCIe-to-PCI/PCI-X；保留舊裝置相容性 | | Function | 軟體可獨立設定的邏輯功能 | 每個 Function 有自己的 Configuration Space 與 BDF |

source_file: 01_架構與拓撲.md
title: Transaction Layer
content: 把裝置核心的讀寫、設定或訊息意圖組成 TLP；在接收端解碼 TLP，完成路由、排序、Flow Control 類別與 Request/Completion 關聯。TLP 的主要 Request 類別是 Memory、I/O、Configuration、Message。〔BOOK p.118-130；BP p.4-6〕

source_file: 01_架構與拓撲.md
title: Data Link Layer
content: 保證「單一 Link 上」的可靠傳輸。它為 TLP 加上 Sequence Number 與 LCRC，使用 Ack/Nak DLLP 和 Replay Buffer 做自動重送，也承載 Flow Control 與部分 Power Management DLLP。〔BOOK p.131-135、366-417；BP p.8-10〕

source_file: 01_架構與拓撲.md
title: Physical Layer
content: 負責 framing、striping、scrambling、encoding、serialization、clock recovery、lane alignment、link training 與電氣訊號。Gen1/2 與 Gen3 的邏輯編碼不同。〔BOOK p.135-138、420-703；BP p.12-13〕 > 層是責任邊界，不強迫晶片內部一定照三個實體模組切割。〔BOOK p.113〕

source_file: 01_架構與拓撲.md
section: 三種在 Link 上出現的流量
title: 三種在 Link 上出現的流量
content: | 類型 | 產生/終止層 | 是否跨 Switch 路由 | 用途 | |---|---|---|---| | TLP | Transaction Layer | 是 | Memory/I/O/Configuration/Message 交易 | | DLLP | Data Link Layer | 否，只在相鄰兩 Port 間 | Ack/Nak、Flow Control、Power Management | | Ordered Set | Physical Layer | 否，只在相鄰 PHY 間 | Training、clock compensation、electrical idle 等 | 只有 TLP 會穿越多個 Link；DLLP 與 Ordered Set 到每一跳即被消耗。這是理解「端到端交易」與「逐跳可靠性」的關鍵。〔BOOK p.206、225〕

source_file: 01_架構與拓撲.md
section: 一次 Memory Read 的端到端視角
title: 一次 Memory Read 的端到端視角
content: 1. Requester 的核心提出目標位址、長度與屬性。 2. Transaction Layer 建立 Memory Read Request TLP；Memory Read 是 Non-Posted。 3. Data Link Layer 加 Sequence Number/LCRC，並保留副本等待 Ack。 4. Physical Layer striping、scrambling、encoding 後送上 Lane。 5. 每一跳先做 PHY/Data Link 檢查與 Ack/Nak；Switch 再依 TLP 位址路由。 6. Completer 取得資料，產生一個或多個 Completion with Data TLP。 7. Completion 依 Requester ID 返回，Requester 用 Transaction ID 對應原始 Request。 這個流程把三種不同可靠性問題分開：PHY 處理訊號、Data Link 處理逐跳錯誤、Transaction Layer 處理端到端語意。〔BOOK p.124、140-143、208；BP p.15〕

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
title: 先後關係
content: PCIe 開機時不是「先有路由再找裝置」，而是： 1. Root 從已知的 Bus 0 開始探測。 2. Enumeration 指派 BDF 與 bridge bus numbers。 3. 軟體量測 BAR 需求並配置 MMIO/I/O 範圍。 4. 軟體把 bridge 的 Base/Limit window 設好。 5. 啟用 Memory Space、Bus Master、MSI/MSI-X、error reporting 等功能。 6. 之後 TLP 才能依地址或 ID 正確穿越 fabric。 〔BOOK p.144-175、180-225〕

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
title: BDF：軟體看到的座標
content: BDF = Bus Number + Device Number + Function Number。 - Bus：8 bits，最多 256 個 bus number。 - Device：5 bits，每 bus 最多 32 個 device number；外部點對點 Link 的下游裝置通常固定為 Device 0。 - Function：傳統欄位 3 bits，每 device 最多 8 個 Function。 - 每個 Function 都有獨立 Configuration Space。 Switch 的 Port 對軟體呈現虛擬 PCI-to-PCI Bridge，因而建立新的 Bus 階層。〔BOOK p.144-145、214〕

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
title: Configuration Space
content: | 區域 | 大小 | 存取方式 | 內容 | |---|---:|---|---| | PCI-Compatible Space | 256 bytes/Function | Legacy CF8/CFC 或 ECAM | 64-byte Header + capability list | | Extended Configuration Space | 總計 4 KB/Function | ECAM | PCIe extended capabilities | Type 0 Header 用於非 Bridge Function（常見為 Endpoint），有 6 個 BAR；Type 1 Header 用於 Bridge/Root Port/Switch Port，有 2 個 BAR 與 Primary/Secondary/Subordinate Bus Number、Base/Limit windows。PCIe Function 至少需要 PCI Express Capability，並支援 Power Management 及 MSI 和/或 MSI-X。〔BOOK p.147-148、185-186〕

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
title: Configuration Request 的限制
content: 只有 Root Complex 可產生 Configuration Request，且只能往下游走；Endpoint 不可任意改寫其他裝置。Configuration TLP 使用 ID Routing。〔BOOK p.150〕

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
title: Type 0 與 Type 1 Configuration Request
content: - 目標 Bus 等於某 Bridge 的 Secondary Bus：往該 bus 送 Type 0，Device/Function 解碼並存取最終 Function。 - 目標 Bus 落在 Secondary..Subordinate 範圍但不等於 Secondary：以 Type 1 繼續往更深層 Bridge 傳遞。 - 到達最終 bus 時，Type 1 轉為 Type 0；這也是 ECRC 計算必須把 Type bit 的可變性排除在外的原因之一。 〔BOOK p.158-160、718〕

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
title: Enumeration：深度優先探索
content: 核心流程： 1. 從 Bus 0、Device 0、Function 0 開始讀 Vendor ID。 2. Vendor ID 有效代表 Function 存在；`FFFFh` 代表不存在。 3. 讀 Header Type 判斷 Endpoint（0）或 PCI-to-PCI Bridge（1）；multi-function bit 決定是否探測 Function 1-7。 4. 發現 Bridge 時，先暫設 Subordinate Bus Number = 255，指派新的 Secondary Bus Number。 5. 立即深入新的 bus，完成其下所有子樹後再回到上一層，最後收斂 Subordinate Bus Number。 這是 depth-first search。〔BOOK p.163-174〕

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
section: 不存在與尚未就緒不可混為一談
title: 不存在與尚未就緒不可混為一談
content: - **Device absent**：下游 Bridge 回 Completion Status = UR；Root 為相容性向軟體呈現全 1，Vendor ID 即 `FFFFh`。 - **Device present but not ready**：Function 可回 CRS。Root 可重試，或在 CRS Software Visibility 啟用且讀 Vendor ID 時回人工值 `0001h`，讓軟體稍後再查。 Enumeration 期間的「探測不到」常是預期事件，不應直接當成一般 runtime error。〔BOOK p.164-166〕

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
title: BAR：向軟體宣告地址需求
content: 裝置不能自行決定系統位址；它用 BAR 表示所需空間的類型、大小與屬性，BIOS/OS 再配置基址。〔BOOK p.185-194〕

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
title: 常見類型
content: - I/O BAR：僅為 legacy 相容，PCIe 不鼓勵新設計依賴 I/O space。 - 32-bit Memory BAR。 - 64-bit Memory BAR：佔用相鄰兩個 BAR dword。 - Prefetchable MMIO：讀取無副作用，允許預取/合併，有利效能。 - Non-Prefetchable MMIO：讀取可能有副作用，常用於控制/狀態暫存器。

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
title: 量測與配置觀念
content: 軟體會保存原值、寫入全 1、讀回硬體固定遮罩以推導 size/type，再寫入已配置的 base address。所有 BAR 都要逐一檢查；即使前一個未實作，也不能假設後面的都不存在。64-bit BAR 需把相鄰 BAR 當成一組。〔BOOK p.185-194〕

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
title: Bridge Window
content: Endpoint 的 BAR 告訴它「哪些地址是我的」；Type 1 Header 的 Base/Limit window 告訴 Bridge「哪些地址位於我的下游」。Bridge 分別維護 Prefetchable MMIO、Non-Prefetchable MMIO、I/O 三類範圍。若任一上游 Bridge window 未涵蓋 Endpoint BAR，即使 Endpoint BAR 正確，Request 仍到不了裝置。〔BOOK p.195-203〕

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
title: 三種 TLP 路由
content: | 路由方法 | 依據 | 典型 TLP | |---|---|---| | Address Routing | 32/64-bit Memory address 或 32-bit I/O address | Memory Read/Write、I/O Read/Write、AtomicOp | | ID Routing | BDF | Configuration Request、Completion、部分 Message | | Implicit Routing | 拓撲方向/既定目的地 | 多數 Message，例如往 Root 或廣播 | 〔BOOK p.204-224；BP p.6〕

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
title: Address Routing
content: Endpoint 以 BAR 判斷是否接受；Switch/Bridge 以 BAR 與 Base/Limit window 判斷消耗、向下游轉發、向上游轉發或回報 Unsupported Request。Memory address < 4 GB 使用 3DW header；高於 4 GB 使用 4DW header。〔BOOK p.217-222〕

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
title: ID Routing
content: 使用 BDF 精準定位 Function。Configuration Request 往下游；Completion 依 Requester ID 返回；某些 Message 也可指定 ID。〔BOOK p.214-216〕

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
title: Implicit Routing
content: 僅適用 Message。它利用樹狀拓撲的上/下游方向與 Root 在頂端的事實，模擬被 PCIe 移除的 sideband signal 語意。〔BOOK p.222-224〕

source_file: 02_組態定址與路由.md
title: 快速診斷問題鏈
content: 若驅動找得到裝置卻無法正常 MMIO，依序檢查： 1. BDF 與 Vendor/Device ID 是否穩定。 2. Header Type、BAR type/size/base 是否合理。 3. Command.Memory Space Enable 是否打開。 4. 每一層上游 Bridge 的 Base/Limit window 是否涵蓋該 BAR。 5. TLP address、3DW/4DW format、Byte Enable、Length 是否正確。 6. Completer 是否回 UR/CA，或 Requester 是否 Completion Timeout。

source_file: 03_事務層與TLP.md
title: Transaction 的基本語法
content: Transaction Layer 接收裝置核心提出的操作，把目標、來源、命令、長度、屬性與資料組成 TLP。一次 Transaction 是一個 Request 加上它所需要的零個或多個 Completion。〔BOOK p.118-124、228-233〕

source_file: 03_事務層與TLP.md
title: Posted 與 Non-Posted
content: | Request | 類別 | Completion | |---|---|---| | Memory Write | Posted | 不得回 Completion | | Message | Posted | 通常不回 Completion | | Memory Read / Memory Read Lock | Non-Posted | 回一個或多個 Completion with Data，或錯誤 Completion | | I/O Read / Write | Non-Posted | 必須回 Completion | | Configuration Read / Write | Non-Posted | 必須回 Completion | | AtomicOp | Non-Posted | 回含原值的 Completion with Data | Memory Write 的 Posted 語意提高效能，但 Requester 不會收到端到端成功通知；逐跳 Data Link Ack 只證明每段 Link 已可靠交付，不等於最終裝置已完成寫入。I/O/Configuration Write 會直接改變裝置狀態，因此保留 Completion。〔BOOK p.119、128、208-209；BP p.5〕

source_file: 03_事務層與TLP.md
title: TLP 結構
content: ```text [Header: 3DW/4DW] [Data Payload: optional, 0-1024 DW] [ECRC: optional, 1DW] ``` - **Header**：12 或 16 bytes；定義 Fmt/Type、Length、TC、Attr、Requester/Completer ID、Tag、Address、Byte Enable 等。 - **Payload**：最大 1024 DW = 4096 bytes；實際可用大小還受 Max Payload Size 等設定限制。 - **ECRC/Digest**：可選的端到端 CRC，保護 Transaction Layer 視角的內容。 - Data Link Layer 之後另加 12-bit Sequence Number 與 32-bit LCRC；它們不是 TLP Header 的一部分。 〔BOOK p.231-242；BP p.5、9〕

source_file: 03_事務層與TLP.md
title: Fmt/Type 決定如何解碼
content: 接收端先用 Fmt 判斷 3DW/4DW 及是否有 Data，再用 Type 判斷 Memory、I/O、Configuration、Completion 或 Message。相同欄位位置會依 TLP 類型有不同意義，所以封包解碼不可只看單一欄位。〔BOOK p.233-239〕

source_file: 03_事務層與TLP.md
title: Transaction Descriptor
content: 跨多跳仍保持的關鍵資訊： - **Transaction ID = Requester ID + Tag**：Requester 用它把 Completion 對回原始 Non-Posted Request。 - **Traffic Class (TC)**：由 Requester 指定，沿路保持；每個 Link 上再映射到某個 VC。 - **Attributes**：Relaxed Ordering、No Snoop、ID-based Ordering 等。 〔BOOK p.241-242〕

source_file: 03_事務層與TLP.md
title: Length、Byte Enable 與對齊
content: - Length 以 DW（4 bytes）為單位，`0000000000b` 編碼代表 1024 DW，而不是 0。 - Payload 第一個 byte 對應最低地址。 - First/Last DW Byte Enable 決定首尾 DW 的有效 byte。 - 中間 DW 必須完整有效；多 DW Request 的 Byte Enable 必須遵守連續性與對齊規則。 - Length 只計 payload，不包含 Header/ECRC。 〔BOOK p.237-242〕

source_file: 03_事務層與TLP.md
title: Read Request 與 Completion
content: Memory Read Request 沒有資料 payload，帶著 address、length、Requester ID 與 Tag。Completer 可把資料拆成多個 Completion with Data；Requester 依 Transaction ID、Byte Count、Lower Address 等欄位重組。單一 Read Request 不保證只回一個 Completion。〔BOOK p.124、255-261〕 常見 Completion Status： - **SC**：Successful Completion。 - **UR**：Unsupported Request。 - **CRS**：Configuration Request Retry Status，只用於 Configuration。 - **CA**：Completer Abort。

source_file: 03_事務層與TLP.md
title: Memory Write 的完成語意
content: Memory Write 沒有 Completion，因此「TLP 已被 Ack」只代表該 Link 的接收端正確收到。若軟體需要確認先前 Posted Write 已在 ordering 規則下向前推進，通常要透過後續 Non-Posted Read/Completion 建立可觀察的 ordering point；不能把 Data Link Ack 當成 device-level commit。〔BOOK p.128-130、344-363〕

source_file: 03_事務層與TLP.md
title: Message TLP
content: Message 把原本的 sideband/特殊事件改成 in-band packet，可承載： - Legacy INTx assert/deassert。 - Power Management event/handshake。 - Error Message（ERR_COR、ERR_NONFATAL、ERR_FATAL）。 - Set Slot Power Limit。 - Vendor-Defined Message。 - 其他規範定義訊息。 Message 多為 Posted，並可依 address、ID 或 implicit routing 傳送。〔BOOK p.262-272、222-224〕

source_file: 03_事務層與TLP.md
title: ECRC 與 LCRC 不同
content: | 項目 | ECRC | LCRC | |---|---|---| | 層級 | Transaction Layer | Data Link Layer | | 範圍 | 端到端；中間 Switch 通常轉送 | 單一 Link；每跳重新產生/檢查 | | 是否可選 | 可選能力 | TLP 逐跳可靠性核心機制 | | 錯誤處理 | AER/ECRC error、可能丟棄或 poison/report | Nak/Replay 或 timeout replay | Header 中合法可變的欄位不直接參與 ECRC 原值計算；書中以 Configuration Type bit 與 EP bit 為例。〔BOOK p.718〕

source_file: 03_事務層與TLP.md
title: 封包閱讀順序
content: 拿到 analyzer trace 時，建議依序判讀： 1. Fmt/Type：這是哪種 TLP、是否帶資料、3DW 或 4DW？ 2. Routing key：Address、Completer ID 或 implicit code？ 3. Requester ID + Tag：能否與 Completion 配對？ 4. Length、Byte Enable、Lower Address、Byte Count：資料範圍是否吻合？ 5. TC/Attr：是否允許重排或映射到不同 VC？ 6. Completion Status 或 EP/TD：是否有錯誤語意？ 7. 再往下看 Sequence Number、LCRC、Ack/Nak；不要把不同層的錯誤混在一起。

source_file: 04_流量控制_QoS與排序.md
title: Credit-Based Flow Control
content: PCIe 不先送 TLP 再等對方說「buffer 滿了」，而是接收端先公告可用 buffer credits；傳送端只有在 credits 足夠時才可送。這避免 receive buffer overflow，也避免 PCI 式 wait-state、disconnect、retry。Flow Control 是每個 Link、每個方向、每個 VC 分別管理。〔BOOK p.274-303；BP p.8〕

source_file: 04_流量控制_QoS與排序.md
title: 六類 Credit
content: 每個 VC 的 TLP buffer 分為三種 traffic category，且 Header/Data 分開： | 類別 | Header Credit | Data Credit | 例子 | |---|---|---|---| | Posted | PH | PD | Memory Write、Message | | Non-Posted | NPH | NPD | Memory Read、Configuration、I/O | | Completion | CPLH | CPLD | Completion / Completion with Data | Read Request 只消耗 NPH；Memory Write 同時消耗 PH 與 PD。傳送前必須確認該 TLP 所需的所有 credit 均足夠。〔BOOK p.277〕

source_file: 04_流量控制_QoS與排序.md
title: Credit 的生命週期
content: 1. Link 初始化時以 InitFC1/InitFC2 類 DLLP 公告初始容量。 2. Transmitter 以本地計數器追蹤已公告上限與已消耗 credit。 3. Receiver 取走/處理 buffer 內容後，發送 UpdateFC DLLP 公告新的可用量。 4. 計數器使用模數運算並允許 rollover，不能用普通大小比較解讀。 DLLP 本身不受 Flow Control，否則更新 credit 的封包可能被 credit 卡住而形成自我死結。〔BOOK p.286-303、368；BP p.8〕

source_file: 04_流量控制_QoS與排序.md
title: Flow Control 不等於 Ack/Nak
content: - Flow Control 回答：「對方有空間收這個類別的 TLP 嗎？」 - Ack/Nak 回答：「剛才送出的 TLP 在這一跳是否正確到達？」 - Completion 回答：「Non-Posted Request 的端到端操作結果是什麼？」 三者位於不同責任層，任何除錯都應先辨識卡在哪一個回饋迴路。

source_file: 04_流量控制_QoS與排序.md
title: Traffic Class (TC)
content: Requester 在 TLP Header 指定 3-bit TC（TC0-TC7）。TC 表示端到端的流量類別，不等同於實體佇列。〔BOOK p.304-343；BP p.7〕

source_file: 04_流量控制_QoS與排序.md
title: Virtual Channel (VC)
content: 每一跳以 TC-to-VC Mapping 把 TC 映射到該 Link 的 VC。VC 有獨立 Flow Control 資源，可隔離流量並降低 head-of-line blocking。VC0 必須存在；其他 VC 是否實作與啟用取決於裝置能力與軟體設定。〔BOOK p.304-343〕

source_file: 04_流量控制_QoS與排序.md
title: VC Arbitration
content: 當多個 VC 同時要使用同一 Physical Link，Port 需仲裁。可採 strict priority 或 weighted round robin 等機制。Strict priority 延遲低但可能餓死低優先流；WRR 可分配頻寬但增加排程複雜度。〔BP p.7；BOOK Ch.7〕 > TC 是封包的端到端分類；VC 是每一 Link 的本地資源與傳送路徑。兩者不可互換。

source_file: 04_流量控制_QoS與排序.md
title: Transaction Ordering
content: Ordering 規則主要適用於相同 TC 的交易；不同 TC 沒有彼此 ordering 關係。不同 VC 也沒有必須維持的 ordering。實作可能為簡化而對整個 VC 採更保守的排序。〔BOOK p.344-346〕

source_file: 04_流量控制_QoS與排序.md
title: Producer/Consumer 動機
content: 典型流程：Producer 先 Posted Write 資料，再寫一個 flag；Consumer 讀 flag，看到更新後才讀資料。若 fabric 讓 flag write 越過 data write，Consumer 可能看到新 flag 卻讀到舊資料。因此某些 Posted Write 之間必須維持順序。〔BOOK p.344-355；BP p.11〕

source_file: 04_流量控制_QoS與排序.md
section: 為何有些封包必須越過前方封包
title: 為何有些封包必須越過前方封包
content: 若所有封包都嚴格 FIFO，Non-Posted Request 或 Completion 可能被前方等待中的 Posted/Non-Posted traffic 卡住，形成 protocol deadlock。PCIe ordering table 同時在「維持程式語意」與「允許必要繞行」間取得平衡。〔BOOK p.344-363〕

source_file: 04_流量控制_QoS與排序.md
title: 效能放寬
content: - **Relaxed Ordering (RO)**：Requester 宣告此交易允許更多重排，以降低阻塞。 - **ID-Based Ordering (IDO)**：在允許條件下，把不同 Requester/Completer ID 的交易視為彼此無依賴。 - **No Snoop (NS)**：描述 cache coherency/snoop 屬性，不是單純「可以亂序」的同義詞。 這些 bit 是效能承諾，也是正確性承諾。只有當軟體、裝置與系統確定沒有資料相依時才可設定。〔BOOK p.242、344-363〕

source_file: 04_流量控制_QoS與排序.md
title: 常見效能瓶頸判讀
content: | 症狀 | 優先檢查 | |---|---| | Link utilization 低、TLP 間大量空洞 | 對端 credits、UpdateFC、Replay、L-state 進出 | | Read latency 高但 Write throughput 正常 | Outstanding tags、Completion latency、RCB/MRRS、CPL credits | | 某流量類別長期飢餓 | TC-to-VC mapping、VC arbitration、strict priority | | 多流合併後吞吐急降 | Head-of-line blocking、是否只有 VC0、ordering 過度保守 | | 週期性吞吐崩落 | Replay timeout、LCRC error、credit update 週期或電源狀態切換 |

source_file: 05_資料連結層.md
title: 責任邊界
content: Data Link Layer 的核心任務是讓 TLP 在「一段 Link」上可靠送達。它不決定端到端路由，也不保證裝置功能已完成；每經過一個 Switch Port，前一跳的 Data Link 封裝結束，下一跳重新產生 Sequence Number/LCRC。〔BOOK p.366-417；BP p.9-10〕

source_file: 05_資料連結層.md
section: TLP 在 Data Link Layer 的封裝
title: TLP 在 Data Link Layer 的封裝
content: ```text [12-bit Sequence Number carried in 2 bytes] [TLP] [32-bit LCRC] ``` Transmitter： 1. 為新 TLP 指派下一個 Sequence Number。 2. 計算涵蓋 Sequence Number、Header、Payload、ECRC 的 LCRC。 3. 把封裝後 TLP 的副本留在 Replay Buffer。 4. 傳送並等待 Ack；收到對應 Ack 才能清除已確認項目。 Receiver： 1. 檢查 Physical Layer 錯誤、LCRC 與 Sequence Number。 2. 正確且符合預期序號的 TLP 交給 Transaction Layer，排程 Ack。 3. 錯誤或遺失序號時丟棄問題資料並排程 Nak。 4. 重複 TLP 不重複交付上層，但可回 Ack 幫助對端收斂。 〔BOOK p.231-233、376-406〕

source_file: 05_資料連結層.md
title: DLLP
content: DLLP 是固定 8 bytes 的 Data Link Layer packet，主要類型： - Ack / Nak。 - InitFC / UpdateFC（Flow Control）。 - Power Management DLLP。 - Vendor-specific DLLP。 DLLP 到相鄰 Port 的 Data Link Layer 就終止，不經 Switch 路由，不受 Flow Control，也沒有 DLLP 自身的 Ack/Nak。它以 16-bit CRC 檢查；錯誤 DLLP 直接丟棄，靠週期性重送或 timeout 恢復。〔BOOK p.366-375、225；BP p.9〕

source_file: 05_資料連結層.md
title: Sequence Number 的滑動視窗
content: Sequence Number 是 12 bits，範圍 0-4095，之後 rollover。比較時要用模數/視窗語意，不能把 0 永遠視為比 4095 小。Transmitter 必須限制未確認範圍，避免 rollover 後新舊序號模糊。〔BOOK p.379、388〕

source_file: 05_資料連結層.md
title: Ack 與 Nak
content: - **Ack**：累積確認，AckNak_Seq_Num 表示至該序號為止已正確收到。 - **Nak**：指出從接收端期待序號開始需要 replay。 - Ack 可延遲/合併以降低 DLLP overhead，但受 AckNak latency timer 限制。 - Nak 或 Replay Timer timeout 會觸發 Replay Buffer 內容重送。 〔BOOK p.376-406；BP p.10〕

source_file: 05_資料連結層.md
title: Replay Buffer
content: Replay Buffer 必須保留所有「已送出但尚未 Ack」的 TLP。收到累積 Ack 後可移除已確認項目；收到 Nak 或 timeout 時，暫停送新 TLP並從指定位置 replay。若反覆 replay 仍無法恢復，會升級成 Data Link Protocol Error。〔BOOK p.379-406〕

source_file: 05_資料連結層.md
title: LCRC、ECRC、DLLP CRC
content: | CRC | 大小 | 保護對象 | 生命週期 | |---|---:|---|---| | LCRC | 32 bits | Data Link 封裝後的 TLP | 每一 Link 重新產生與檢查 | | ECRC | 32 bits | Transaction Layer 的端到端 TLP 內容 | 可跨 Switch 保留至最終接收端 | | DLLP CRC | 16 bits | DLLP 本身 | 單一 Link；壞 DLLP 丟棄 |

source_file: 05_資料連結層.md
title: 正常
content: TLP 10、11、12 到達，Receiver 累積回 Ack 12；Transmitter 可從 Replay Buffer 一次清掉三個。

source_file: 05_資料連結層.md
title: TLP/LCRC 錯誤
content: Receiver 期待 11 卻檢到錯誤，丟棄並回 Nak 10；Transmitter 從尚未確認的下一筆開始 replay。

source_file: 05_資料連結層.md
title: Ack 遺失
content: Ack 本身 CRC 錯而被丟棄，不代表 TLP 未送達。後續累積 Ack 可一次確認更多 TLP；若一直沒有新 Ack，Replay Timer 到期後 Transmitter 重送，Receiver 辨識 duplicate、丟棄副本並再回 Ack。〔BOOK p.406〕

source_file: 05_資料連結層.md
title: 除錯判斷
content: 看到大量 Replay 時先問： 1. 是 LCRC/Physical error 導致 Nak，還是 Ack 遺失導致 timeout？ 2. 是否集中在單一 Lane、速度、方向或電源狀態切換後？ 3. Replay 後是否成功，或最後轉成 Data Link Protocol Error/Link Recovery？ 4. Flow Control credit 是否正常？不要把「不能送」誤判成「送了又錯」。

source_file: 06_實體層與LTSSM.md
title: Physical Layer 的工作
content: Physical Layer 分成 Logical 與 Electrical 觀念區塊，負責： - TLP/DLLP framing 與 Ordered Set 插入。 - 多 Lane byte striping、接收端 un-striping/de-skew。 - Scrambling/descrambling。 - Gen1/2 的 8b/10b 或 Gen3 的 128b/130b。 - Serialization/deserialization、clock data recovery、elastic buffer。 - Link detection、training、速度/寬度協商、polarity inversion、可選 lane reversal。 - 電氣訊號、通道損耗、equalization 與眼圖裕量。 〔BOOK p.420-703；BP p.12-13〕

source_file: 06_實體層與LTSSM.md
title: 傳送與接收管線
content: ```text Tx: packet bytes -> framing -> byte striping -> scrambling -> encoding -> serializer -> differential link Rx: differential link -> CDR/deserializer -> decoding -> descrambling -> de-skew/un-striping -> packet filtering ``` 實際順序與細節依 Gen1/2 或 Gen3 而異；規範定義行為責任，不強迫某一微架構。〔BOOK p.423-431〕

source_file: 06_實體層與LTSSM.md
title: Gen1/Gen2 與 Gen3
content: | 特性 | Gen1/Gen2 | Gen3 | |---|---|---| | Signaling rate | 2.5 / 5.0 GT/s | 8.0 GT/s | | Encoding | 8b/10b | 128b/130b | | 編碼 overhead | 20% | 約 1.54% | | 邊界/控制 | K-code control characters | 2-bit Sync Header、Data/Ordered-Set Blocks、Framing Tokens | | 鎖定 | Bit + Symbol Lock | Bit + Block Alignment | | Equalization | 較固定的 Tx de-emphasis | 更完整的 Tx/Rx Equalization 與 training phases | Gen3 沒把速率直接拉到 10 GT/s，而是以 8 GT/s 配合低 overhead 編碼，達到接近 Gen2 兩倍的有效頻寬，同時需要更強的信號補償。〔BOOK p.102、440、466-474；BP p.13〕

source_file: 06_實體層與LTSSM.md
title: 8b/10b 的目的
content: 8b/10b 不只是浪費 20% 頻寬；它提供 transition density、DC balance、control character 與非法碼檢出能力。Receiver 用 COM character 找到 10-bit Symbol 邊界；running disparity 協助維持 DC balance。〔BOOK p.440-455〕

source_file: 06_實體層與LTSSM.md
title: Gen3 128b/130b
content: 每 Lane 的 Block 是 2-bit Sync Header + 128 bits payload。Sync Header 區分 Data Block 與 Ordered Set Block；Data Block 內用 Token 表示 STP、SDP、END/EDB、IDL 等 framing 語意。Scrambling 仍用來改善頻譜特性，但不再靠 8b/10b K-code。〔BOOK p.466-505〕

source_file: 06_實體層與LTSSM.md
title: Multi-Lane
content: - Byte Striping 把連續 bytes 依序分配到各 Lane，提高並行頻寬。 - 接收端需做 Lane-to-Lane de-skew 後才能還原原始順序。 - Lane polarity inversion 必須由 Receiver 自動偵測並校正。 - Lane reversal 是可選能力；板級設計不能假設兩端必定支援。 - Link 可降寬運作，但需透過 LTSSM 協商。 〔BOOK p.431、564-575；BP p.12〕

source_file: 06_實體層與LTSSM.md
title: Ordered Sets
content: Ordered Set 由 Physical Layer 產生與消耗，常見用途： - TS1/TS2：Link training、Link/Lane number、速度能力、控制資訊。 - SKP Ordered Set：clock tolerance compensation，避免 elastic buffer overflow/underflow。 - FTS：從 L0s 回 L0 時協助快速重新取得 lock。 - EIOS/EIEOS：進出 Electrical Idle。 - Compliance patterns：電氣量測與符合性測試。 Ordered Set 不上交 Data Link Layer，也不跨 Switch 路由。〔BOOK p.448、564-703〕

source_file: 06_實體層與LTSSM.md
title: LTSSM 高層地圖
content: ```text Detect -> Polling -> Configuration -> L0 ^ | | +-> Recovery -> L0 / Configuration +------------------------------ L0 <-> L0s L0 <-> L1 L0 -> L2 -> Detect Disabled / Loopback / Hot Reset / Compliance 為特殊分支 ``` - **Detect**：偵測對端 receiver termination。 - **Polling**：建立 bit/symbol/block lock，交換 training ordered sets。 - **Configuration**：協商 Link/Lane number 與最終 width。 - **L0**：正常 TLP/DLLP 流量。 - **Recovery**：重新取得 lock、重訓、變更速度/寬度、Gen3 equalization。 - **L0s/L1/L2**：逐漸更深的低功耗 Link state，退出延遲與保存內容不同。 〔BOOK p.564-703〕

source_file: 06_實體層與LTSSM.md
section: 上電一定先從 Gen1 開始
title: 上電一定先從 Gen1 開始
content: Link training 為相容性先以 2.5 GT/s 建立；若兩端宣告更高速率，進入 Recovery 嘗試升至共同支援的最高速度。看到裝置先 Gen1 後進 Recovery 不一定是錯誤，而是正常升速流程。〔BOOK p.466、630〕

source_file: 06_實體層與LTSSM.md
title: Gen3 Equalization
content: Gen3 在 Recovery.Equalization 交換 preset/coefficient，分 phase 協調兩端 transmitter 設定並由 receiver 評估。若通道條件或設定不合適，可能停在較低速度、重複 Recovery，或發生 correctable errors/replay。〔BOOK p.469、630-656〕

source_file: 06_實體層與LTSSM.md
section: 電氣與協定症狀的連結
title: 電氣與協定症狀的連結
content: | 觀察 | 可能層級 | |---|---| | Detect 反覆失敗 | termination、連接器、電源/Reset、Lane wiring | | Polling/Configuration 反覆 | TS1/TS2、lock、Lane numbering、polarity、width negotiation | | Gen1/2 正常但 Gen3 失敗 | insertion loss、equalization、jitter、preset/coefficient、通道裕量 | | L0 中 LCRC/Nak 增加 | BER、crosstalk、clock/power noise、邊界條件 | | 進出 L0s/L1 後才失敗 | electrical idle exit、FTS/EIEOS、ASPM timing |

source_file: 07_系統主題.md
title: Error Detection and Handling
content: PCIe 把錯誤處理拆成四件事：Detection、Logging、Reporting、Signaling。偵測到錯誤不代表一定會通知 Root；是否記錄、遮罩、改變 severity 或傳送 Error Message 由能力與設定決定。〔BOOK p.706-761〕

source_file: 07_系統主題.md
title: Baseline 與 AER
content: - **Baseline Error Reporting**：所有 PCIe 裝置必須支援，保留 PCI 相容狀態與基本 PCIe 錯誤資訊。 - **Advanced Error Reporting (AER)**：可選 extended capability，細分 correctable/uncorrectable status、mask、severity、First Error Pointer、Header Log 等。 〔BOOK p.709-761〕

source_file: 07_系統主題.md
title: 嚴重度
content: | 類別 | 意義 | 常見反應 | |---|---|---| | Correctable | 硬體已恢復，資料/協定可繼續 | 記錄、計數、ERR_COR；例如 receiver error、replay 類事件 | | Uncorrectable Non-Fatal | 該交易受影響，但 Function/Link 可能繼續 | ERR_NONFATAL、驅動/OS 復原 | | Uncorrectable Fatal | Link/Function 狀態可能不可靠 | ERR_FATAL、reset/recovery/isolation | 實際分類與升級受 AER severity 設定及 agent role 影響。〔BOOK p.706-750〕

source_file: 07_系統主題.md
title: 錯誤保護層次
content: - PHY：解碼、framing、lock、electrical error。 - Data Link：LCRC、Sequence、Replay，處理逐跳可恢復錯誤。 - Transaction：Malformed TLP、UR、CA、Completion Timeout、ECRC、Poisoned TLP。 - Software/AER：記錄來源、嚴重度、header，決定 reset/隔離策略。 若 Link 已壞到下游無法回報，上游 Port 必須代表該 Link 回報；軟體可嘗試 retrain。〔BOOK p.742〕

source_file: 07_系統主題.md
section: Function D-state 與 Link L-state 是兩條軸
title: Function D-state 與 Link L-state 是兩條軸
content: - **D0/D1/D2/D3hot/D3cold**：Function 的電源/功能狀態。 - **L0/L0s/L1/L2/L3**：Link 的傳輸/低功耗狀態。 Function state 與 Link state 有合法組合及轉換條件，但不能把 D3 與 L1 當成同一件事。系統由 OS、PCIe bus driver、device driver、firmware/ACPI 分工。〔BOOK p.762-851〕

source_file: 07_系統主題.md
title: ASPM 與軟體導向 PM
content: - ASPM 可在 Link 閒置時硬體自動進入 L0s/L1。 - 軟體導向 Link PM 透過 PM handshake 協調更深狀態。 - 更深狀態通常節能更多，但退出 latency 更大，且可能需要更多 context restore/retraining。 - PME 讓裝置在低功耗狀態請求喚醒系統。 〔BOOK Ch.16；BOOK p.564-703〕

source_file: 07_系統主題.md
title: Interrupt
content: | 方法 | 形式 | 特性 | |---|---|---| | Legacy INTx emulation | Assert/Deassert INTx Message | 為 PCI 相容保留，level-like 語意 | | MSI | Memory Write TLP | In-band、可配置 message address/data | | MSI-X | Memory Write TLP + table/PBA | 更多 vectors、逐 vector mask、較適合高效能多佇列裝置 | PCIe 不需要實體 INTx pin 穿越 Link；MSI 支援在 PCIe 裝置中是核心要求，實務上優先使用 MSI/MSI-X。〔BOOK p.852-891〕

source_file: 07_系統主題.md
title: Reset
content: 原書描述四類： - **Cold Reset**：移除再恢復 main power 的 Fundamental Reset。 - **Warm Reset**：不移除 main power 的 Fundamental Reset，可透過 PERST# 或內部事件。 - **Hot Reset**：透過 training sequence 在 Link 內傳播，針對下游 hierarchy。 - **Function-Level Reset (FLR)**：只重設單一 Function，盡量不影響同裝置其他 Function 或整條 Link。 Reset 後要重新考慮 Configuration Space、BAR、bus mastering、MSI/MSI-X、AER、device-specific context 與 link training。〔BOOK p.892-905〕

source_file: 07_系統主題.md
title: Hot Plug 與 Power Budgeting
content: Hot Plug 不只是 presence detect；完整模型涉及： - Attention Button/Indicator、Power Controller、Latch/Interlock、Presence Detect。 - Slot Capability/Control/Status。 - 插入/移除事件通知與 OS 協調。 - surprise removal 能力與錯誤隔離。 - Slot Power Limit Value/Scale 與 Set Slot Power Limit Message。 軟體與 firmware 依系統電源及散熱能力設定 slot power limit；卡在被配置/允許前不應超出初始限制。〔BOOK p.906-945〕

source_file: 07_系統主題.md
title: 2.1 更新與 3.0 範圍提醒
content: MindShare 書把 Resizable BAR、ARI/IDO、AtomicOp、LTR、OBFF、Multicast 等演進內容散布在各章，並在 Chapter 20 彙整 2.1 更新。閱讀時要分辨： - PCIe 基本必備能力。 - 某版本新增但可選的 capability。 - 平台/裝置宣告後才成立的行為。 不要因為書中描述某功能，就假設所有 PCIe 3.0 裝置都實作或啟用。〔BOOK p.946-975〕

source_file: 08_除錯手冊.md
section: 原則：先定位層，再解碼細節
title: 原則：先定位層，再解碼細節
content: PCIe trace 已經過 serializing、encoding、scrambling 與 multi-lane striping；只看示波器波形通常無法直接讀出 TLP。Protocol analyzer 需處理 lane skew、polarity、lane reversal、descrambling、decoding 與 packet reconstruction。〔BOOK p.976-993；BP p.14〕

source_file: 08_除錯手冊.md
title: 分層決策樹
content: ```text 裝置完全看不到 -> Power / clock / PERST# -> Detect 是否看到 receiver termination -> LTSSM 是否到 L0 -> Configuration Read 是否收到 UR/CRS/SC 裝置可枚舉但驅動無法啟動 -> BAR / bridge windows / Command bits -> MSI/MSI-X / reset state / device-specific init -> UR / CA / Completion Timeout / AER 可運作但不穩或效能差 -> negotiated speed/width -> Flow Control credits / VC / ordering -> LCRC, Nak, Replay, Recovery 次數 -> ASPM / L0s / L1 進出 -> Gen3 equalization / signal integrity ```

source_file: 08_除錯手冊.md
title: 1. Link bring-up
content: 記錄： - LTSSM 最後狀態與反覆跳轉路徑。 - Advertised 與 negotiated speed/width。 - 哪些 Lane active；是否發生 lane reversal/polarity inversion。 - TS1/TS2 中的 Link/Lane number、speed change、equalization control。 - 是否只能 Gen1、只能降寬，或進 Recovery 後才失敗。 判讀： - 卡 Detect：先查 termination、電源、參考時鐘、PERST#、連接器與 Lane 對。 - 卡 Polling：查 bit/symbol/block lock、training ordered sets 與 signal quality。 - 卡 Configuration：查 Link/Lane numbering、de-skew、width negotiation。 - L0 後反覆 Recovery：查速度切換、Gen3 equalization、BER、電源狀態退出。 〔BOOK p.564-703〕

source_file: 08_除錯手冊.md
title: 2. Enumeration
content: 最小 trace： 1. Configuration Read Vendor ID。 2. Completion Status 與資料。 3. Header Type / multifunction bit。 4. Bridge Primary/Secondary/Subordinate Bus Number 寫入。 5. 深度優先探測順序。 6. BAR sizing 與 BAR base 寫回。 異常分類： - `FFFFh` + UR：常是該 BDF 不存在，enumeration 中可能正常。 - CRS：裝置存在但未就緒；確認 Root/軟體重試策略與時序。 - Completion Timeout：路徑、Link 或 Completer 行為異常。 - Bus number/window 錯：下層裝置可能完全無法再被探測。 〔BOOK p.163-175〕

source_file: 08_除錯手冊.md
title: 3. 地址與 TLP 路由
content: 檢查： - Type 0/Type 1 Header 是否符合 Function 類型。 - BAR 的 size/type/prefetchable/64-bit 解讀是否正確。 - Endpoint BAR address 與每層 Bridge Base/Limit 是否包含。 - 32-bit address 使用 3DW、64-bit address 使用 4DW。 - Switch ingress/egress 方向是否符合 Address/ID/Implicit routing 規則。 典型錯誤：BAR 配到位址，但上游任一 Bridge window 未開；此時 driver 看到 BDF，卻對 MMIO 存取得到 UR 或 timeout。〔BOOK p.180-225〕

source_file: 08_除錯手冊.md
title: 4. Request/Completion 配對
content: 對每個 Non-Posted Request 建表： | 欄位 | 用途 | |---|---| | Requester ID + Tag | 與 Completion 配對 | | Address + Length + Byte Enable | 預期資料範圍 | | TC + Attr | ordering / VC / snoop 語意 | | Timestamp | 計算 completion latency/timeout | | Completion Status | SC、UR、CRS、CA | | Byte Count + Lower Address | 重組多個 Completion | 不要假設一個 Read 只對一個 Completion。Tag 未釋放、Completion 重複/遺失或 Byte Count 不連續，都可能造成 timeout 或資料重組錯誤。〔BOOK p.243-261〕

source_file: 08_除錯手冊.md
title: 5. Flow Control 與效能
content: 同時看 PH/PD/NPH/NPD/CPLH/CPLD： - 哪一類 credit 為零？ - UpdateFC 是否持續返回？ - 是 receiver buffer 未釋放，還是 DLLP 遺失/timeout？ - 多個 TC 是否全映射 VC0，造成 head-of-line blocking？ - arbitration 是否讓低優先 VC 飢餓？ 只看 Link utilization 無法區分「沒有工作」「沒 credit」「等待 Completion」「Replay 中」或「低功耗狀態」。〔BOOK p.274-343〕

source_file: 08_除錯手冊.md
title: 6. Ack/Nak、Replay 與 BER
content: 建立時間線：TLP Sequence Number -> Ack/Nak -> Replay Timer -> Replay -> Recovery。 - Nak 緊跟 LCRC/sequence error：較像實際傳輸錯誤。 - 沒有 Nak，但 Replay Timer 到期：可能 Ack DLLP 遺失或對端回饋異常。 - Replay 成功且不頻繁：Data Link 機制正常修復。 - Replay storm、反覆 Recovery、降速後消失：強烈指向 PHY/channel margin。 〔BOOK p.376-417〕

source_file: 08_除錯手冊.md
title: 7. Error/AER 收斂
content: 收集順序： 1. Root Port 與 Endpoint 的 AER Correctable/Uncorrectable Status。 2. Mask、Severity、First Error Pointer。 3. Header Log 與 Error Source ID。 4. Link Status、Device Status、Root Error Status。 5. 同一時間的 analyzer trace 與 LTSSM/Replay 計數。 清 status 前先保存完整快照；RW1C bit 清掉後，第一次錯誤線索可能無法還原。〔BOOK p.706-761〕

source_file: 08_除錯手冊.md
title: 8. Reset/Power/Hot Plug
content: 若問題只在 resume/reset/hot plug 後出現： - 確認 reset 類型（Fundamental/Hot/FLR）與影響範圍。 - 檢查裝置 context、BAR、MSI/MSI-X、Bus Master、AER 是否需重設。 - 對照 D-state 與 L-state，不把 Function off 和 Link low-power 混為一談。 - 關閉 ASPM 做 A/B test 只能定位方向，不應當成最終原因。 - Surprise removal 要檢查 pending transactions、error containment 與 driver teardown。 〔BOOK p.762-945〕

source_file: 08_除錯手冊.md
title: 建議的問題報告模板
content: ```text 平台/拓撲：Root Port -> Switch ports -> Endpoint BDF 裝置/韌體版本： 重現步驟與機率： 預期 / 實際： Negotiated speed/width： LTSSM 最後狀態與狀態歷程： Config Space 快照：Header, BAR, Link, Device, AER, MSI/MSI-X AER First Error + Header Log： 第一個異常 TLP/DLLP/Ordered Set： Sequence/Ack/Nak/Replay 時間線： 是否只在 Gen3、特定 width、ASPM、reset/resume 發生： ```

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
title: 術語表
content: | 術語 | 中文解釋 | |---|---| | Ack / Nak | Data Link Layer 對 TLP 接收結果的正/負確認 DLLP | | AER | Advanced Error Reporting，進階錯誤狀態、遮罩、嚴重度與記錄能力 | | ASPM | Active State Power Management，Link 在 active/idle 間自動進低功耗 | | BAR | Base Address Register，Function 宣告並接受 MMIO/I/O 範圍的設定欄位 | | BDF | Bus/Device/Function，Function 在 PCI 拓撲中的邏輯 ID | | Byte Enable | 指定 TLP 首尾 DW 中哪些 byte 有效 | | Completion | 回應 Non-Posted Request 的 TLP，可帶資料或只帶狀態 | | CPLH/CPLD | Completion Header/Data credit | | CRS | Configuration Request Retry Status，Function 暫時未能回應設定存取 | | DLLP | Data Link Layer Packet，只在相鄰 Port 間，承載 Ack/Nak、FC、PM 等 | | DW | Doubleword，4 bytes | | ECRC | End-to-End CRC / TLP Digest，可選的 Transaction Layer 完整性保護 | | Endpoint | 位於 PCIe 拓撲葉節點的功能裝置 | | FLR | Function-Level Reset，只重設指定 Function | | Flow Control Credit | Receiver 公告的可用 buffer 資源計數 | | LCRC | Link CRC，單一 Link 上保護 TLP Data Link 封裝 | | Link | 兩個 PCIe Port 間的點對點連線，由一條或多條 Lane 組成 | | LTSSM | Link Training and Status State Machine | | MPS | Max Payload Size，單一帶資料 TLP 可用的最大 payload 設定 | | MRRS | Max Read Request Size，Requester 單一 Memory Read 可要求的最大資料量 | | MSI/MSI-X | 以 Memory Write TLP 傳送的 in-band interrupt 機制 | | NPH/NPD | Non-Posted Header/Data credit | | Ordered Set | Physical Layer 的 training/clock/power/control 序列，不跨 Link 路由 | | PH/PD | Posted Header/Data credit | | Posted | 不期待 Completion 的 Request；典型為 Memory Write | | Non-Posted | 需要 Completion 的 Request；典型為 Read/Configuration/I/O | | Replay Buffer | 保存尚未 Ack 的 TLP，以便 Nak 或 timeout 後重送 | | Root Complex | CPU/Memory 與 PCIe hierarchy 的介面 | | Root Port | Root Complex 對外連接一條 PCIe Link 的 Port | | Switch | 以多個 PCI-to-PCI Bridge/Port 呈現、負責 TLP fan-out/routing 的元件 | | Tag | Requester 分配給 Non-Posted Request，用於配對 Completion | | TC | Traffic Class，TLP 的端到端流量類別 | | TLP | Transaction Layer Packet，承載 Memory/I/O/Configuration/Message 交易 | | UR | Unsupported Request | | VC | Virtual Channel，每一 Link 的本地虛擬流量/Flow Control 資源 |

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
section: PCIe 是 bus 還是 network？
title: PCIe 是 bus 還是 network？
content: 軟體模型延續 PCI bus hierarchy，但實體/協定行為更像點對點 switched fabric。把它只看成共享 bus 會誤解頻寬、路由與可靠性。〔BOOK p.98-107〕

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
section: x16 是否代表每一 Lane 都有 16 bits？
title: x16 是否代表每一 Lane 都有 16 bits？
content: 不是。x16 表示 16 條 Lane；每條 Lane 是一組 Tx 差動對與一組 Rx 差動對。〔BOOK p.105〕

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
title: GT/s 為何不等於 GB/s？
content: GT/s 是每秒傳輸符號/bit interval；有效 bytes 還要扣 encoding overhead。Gen1/2 用 8b/10b，Gen3 用 128b/130b，且單向與雙向合計必須分清楚。〔BOOK p.102；BP p.13〕

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
section: Switch 會轉送 Ack/Nak 嗎？
title: Switch 會轉送 Ack/Nak 嗎？
content: 不會。Ack/Nak 是 DLLP，只屬於單一 Link。Switch 接收 TLP 後在下一條 Link 重新封裝並使用另一組 Sequence/LCRC/Ack/Nak。〔BOOK p.225、376-417〕

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
section: Memory Write 收到 Ack 是否代表資料已寫入最終裝置？
title: Memory Write 收到 Ack 是否代表資料已寫入最終裝置？
content: 不代表。Ack 只確認一跳正確接收；Memory Write 是 Posted，沒有端到端 Completion。〔BOOK p.119、128〕

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
section: 為什麼 I/O Write 和 Configuration Write 仍需要 Completion？
title: 為什麼 I/O Write 和 Configuration Write 仍需要 Completion？
content: 這些操作通常直接改變裝置行為，需要確認是否成功；所以它們是 Non-Posted。〔BOOK p.119、209〕

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
section: BAR 與 Bridge Base/Limit 有何差別？
title: BAR 與 Bridge Base/Limit 有何差別？
content: BAR 讓 Function 宣告/接受自己的地址；Base/Limit window 讓每個上游 Bridge 知道哪些地址要往該下游子樹轉發。兩者缺一不可。〔BOOK p.185-203〕

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
section: Vendor ID 讀到 FFFFh 一定是硬體壞掉嗎？
title: Vendor ID 讀到 FFFFh 一定是硬體壞掉嗎？
content: 不一定。Enumeration 探測不存在的 BDF 時，Root 會把 UR 轉成全 1，這是正常的「不存在」表示。若預期裝置存在，再往 Link、bus number、reset/power 與 routing 查。〔BOOK p.164-165〕

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
section: CRS 與 UR 有何不同？
title: CRS 與 UR 有何不同？
content: UR 常表示目標不存在或不支援該 Request；CRS 表示 Configuration 目標存在但暫時未就緒，軟體/Root 應按規則稍後重試。〔BOOK p.165-166〕

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
section: Flow Control 和 Replay 是否都在處理「重送」？
title: Flow Control 和 Replay 是否都在處理「重送」？
content: 不是。Flow Control 在送出前確認 buffer 空間；Replay 是送出後偵測傳輸錯誤或 Ack timeout 才重送。〔BOOK p.274-303、376-417〕

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
section: TC 和 VC 是同一個優先權嗎？
title: TC 和 VC 是同一個優先權嗎？
content: 不是。TC 是 TLP 上的端到端分類；每一條 Link 再以 TC-to-VC Mapping 映射到本地 VC。VC 擁有各自 credits 與 arbitration。〔BOOK Ch.7；BP p.7〕

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
section: Gen3 為何只到 8 GT/s 卻接近 Gen2 兩倍有效資料率？
title: Gen3 為何只到 8 GT/s 卻接近 Gen2 兩倍有效資料率？
content: 因為 Gen3 把 8b/10b 的 20% overhead 改為 128b/130b 約 1.54% overhead。〔BOOK p.102、466-469；BP p.13〕

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
section: Link 為何上電先跑 Gen1？
title: Link 為何上電先跑 Gen1？
content: 為相容性，training 先以 2.5 GT/s 建立；若雙方支援更高速度，再進 Recovery 升速。〔BOOK p.466、630〕

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
section: L0s/L1 與 D0/D3 怎麼分？
title: L0s/L1 與 D0/D3 怎麼分？
content: L-state 是 Link；D-state 是 Function。裝置可處於某個 D-state，同時 Link 有另一個 L-state，兩者由規範限制合法組合。〔BOOK Ch.14、Ch.16〕

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
section: LCRC 正常是否表示資料端到端沒有被破壞？
title: LCRC 正常是否表示資料端到端沒有被破壞？
content: 只表示本 Link 的 Data Link 封裝通過檢查。跨 Switch 的內部錯誤或端到端內容問題需依 ECRC、poison、AER 與 Completion 語意判斷。〔BOOK p.718〕

source_file: 09_術語與FAQ.md
section: 大量 Correctable Error 可以忽略嗎？
title: 大量 Correctable Error 可以忽略嗎？
content: 硬體雖已恢復，但持續增加通常代表 channel margin、clock/power noise、connector 或 equalization 問題，且 Replay 會傷害效能；應看趨勢、位置與速度/寬度關聯。〔BOOK Ch.15〕
